response.original_title: ❖『Official-Guide』❖ How do I add a passenger on a Virgin Voyages Cruise?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing Virgin Voyages Cruise booking by calling Virgin Voyages customer service directly at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or by contacting your travel agent Important Details to Know No Online Options: You cannot add a passenger through the Virgin Voyages website or mobile app. Capacity Rules: Additions depend on your stateroom's maximum capacity, overall ship occupancy, and lifeboat limits. At least one original guest must remain on the booking. Pricing Changes: Adding a guest may cause your booking to be re-priced at current prevailing fare rates. Required Information: Have your current booking number, the new passenger's full legal name, and their date of birth ready when you call +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK).
